tagline: Smart Reusable Container Return System & Circular Economy Platform for Campuses

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

layouts_and_grids.landing: Asymmetric Swiss grid layout with hero section featuring floating glass badges, 5-stage Circular Economy timeline (REUSE -> RETURN -> REFUND -> CLEAN -> REUSE), impact stats, YESIST12 2026 competition ribbon, and SDG badges (11, 12, 13).
layouts_and_grids.student_portal: Mode B High Density Dashboard with sidebar navigation, container status overview cards, active RFID container ledger, INR refund wallet balance widget, deposit quick-topup modal, return history timeline, and sustainability impact tree counter.
layouts_and_grids.canteen_admin_portal: Dense Operations Command Center with real-time container issuance scanner, simulated RFID container return verifier, industrial washing queue batch system, student account ledger with INR transaction history, and Recharts analytics (return rate %, waste saved kg, reuse turnover velocity).
layouts_and_grids.kiosk_simulator: Full-screen interactive Touchscreen Kiosk UI with step-by-step simulated hardware triggers (Tap Student RFID -> Place Container on Weight Scale -> RFID Read Simulation -> Weight Validation Sensor -> Instant Deposit Credit INR ₹30 Animation -> Audio Beep & Receipt).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='kiosk-tap-id-button', data-testid='issue-container-submit').
Use Lucide-React icons for UI indicators (e.g. RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Wallet, QrCode, HardDrive, Leaf, Recycle, Scale, Droplets).

Build seamless mock data pre-populated with realistic campus container activity (e.g., GreenBowl RFID #8942, Campus Bento #1204, EcoTiffin #5521) so the platform is fully interactive immediately upon loading.
Implement the full Kiosk Simulator with realistic hardware step transitions (Simulate RFID Scan, Simulate Strain Gauge Weight Check 240g ± 15g, Simulate Sanitize Jet, Refund INR ₹30 trigger).
Provide clear role switching between Student Demo Mode, Canteen Admin Dashboard, and IoT Return Kiosk Simulator via a persistent top banner or switcher.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without full gradients; avoid muddy backgrounds.
Layer cards with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphic backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md) for depth.
Never use generic centered layouts or Inter font for main headings; use Outfit or similar display typography.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; always add blur and bg-opacity.
Ensure sonner toasts confirm actions like 'Container Issued', 'Deposit Refunded (₹30)', or 'Sanitization Queue Updated'.
